1. Self-awareness: Begin by understanding your values, strengths, passions, and weaknesses. Reflect on what brings you joy and fulfillment, as well as what challenges you and motivates you.

5. Listen to your intuition: Pay attention to your gut feelings and synchronicities. Sometimes, our inner voice guides us towards our purpose.

6. Connect with others: Seek advice from mentors, friends, or family members who know you well. They might offer valuable insights or perspectives.
